lines.t: (Intro)
Yeah…
This one’s for the nights I almost lost it all.
But grace—yeah, grace pulled me back.
(Verse 1)
I was locked in a battle I built in my brain,
Tryna outrun guilt, tryna numb the pain.
Every sin I stacked up felt like a chain,
Til I heard that voice say, “Son, I took the blame.”
I was raised on anger, fear, and pride,
Walkin’ through hell with a mask to hide.
But the fire inside wasn’t just my shame,
It was You burnin’ through every lie I claimed.
Now I’m done with the fake, done with the front,
Every lyric I spit got truth in the blunt.
If grace is the weapon, I’m cocked, I’m aimed,
I’m saved, not tamed—still callin’ Your name.
Through the pain, through the rain,
You gave me life, broke every chain.
When I fall, You pull me in,
Yeah, by Your love, I rise again.
Through the pain, through the rain,
You gave me life, broke every chain.
When I fall, You pull me in,
Yeah, by Your love, I rise again.
(Verse 2)
I was chasin’ fame, I was playin’ the clown,
Every high I hit just brought me down.
Couldn’t find peace in the noise and the crowd,
But You whispered truth so quiet, so loud.
Now I’m standin’ on rock, not sand,
Got scars on my soul, but You hold my hand.
Yeah, the devil still talks, I just tune that out,
Every bar I drop is a faith-filled shout.
This ain’t a show—this redemption’s real,
He took my wounds, now they start to heal.
Every verse is a prayer, every rhyme’s a spark,
That lights up hope when the world goes dark.
You want real? This is real.
I was broken, I was bitter, I was tryin’ to steal
Some peace from a world that don’t care if you bleed—
But God reached down and planted that seed.
(Final Chorus)
Through the pain, through the rain,
You gave me life, broke every chain.
When I fall, You pull me in,
Yeah, by Your love, I rise again.
Through the fight, through the flame,
Your mercy burns in my veins.
I’m alive, forgiven, and free—
Yeah, You rose in me.
